# NexaHubTech

> NexaHubTech is a Nigerian software company with two arms: a software studio that designs, builds and maintains software for businesses, and NexaHubTech Academy, which teaches practical technology skills — online and in person — and develops the talent our engineering work depends on.

Tagline: "Design. Ship. Support." Based at Phase 2, F01 Building Materials Market, Kubwa, FCT-Abuja, Nigeria (CAC RC 9545130). Its two arms each have their own pages: the software studio, under the NexaHubTech name, and NexaHubTech Academy. Every Academy course is taught live and starts whenever the student is ready, online or in person (no more than 6 per in-person class, priced above a place online).  and CBT training are taught in person only. Fees can be paid in instalments. Prices are in Nigerian naira (NGN). Contact: nexahubt@gmail.com, +234 913 451 3173, WhatsApp https://wa.me/2349134513173.

Each link below is the markdown version of a page on https://nexahubtech.company; drop the `.md` suffix for the HTML page.

## Start here

- [Home](https://nexahubtech.company/home.md): NexaHubTech designs, builds and maintains production software for businesses and founders — scoped carefully, built properly, and supported long after launch. Based in Abuja, Nigeria.

## NexaHubTech Academy

NexaHubTech Academy is the training arm of NexaHubTech, alongside its software studio. It teaches software development, data, office productivity and video in live, instructor-led courses — online or in person, starting any day.

- [NexaHubTech Academy](https://nexahubtech.company/academy.md): NexaHubTech Academy, the training arm of NexaHubTech, offers live, instructor-led courses in software development, data, office productivity and video. Learn online or in person, start any day, and pay in instalments.
- [Courses](https://nexahubtech.company/courses.md): Every NexaHubTech Academy course, from first steps on a computer to React, data analysis and video — taught live, online or in person, with flexible payment plans. Start any day.
- [WAEC & JAMB CBT Training](https://nexahubtech.company/cbt.md): Get comfortable with the computer-based exam before the day. CBT practice for JAMB and WAEC candidates at NexaHubTech Academy, Phase 2, F01 Building Materials Market, Kubwa: keyboard shortcuts, pacing, past questions and timed mock exams.
- [Pricing](https://nexahubtech.company/fees.md): Simple, all-inclusive pricing for every NexaHubTech Academy course: one fee for the whole course, online or in person, paid in full or in parts — plus CBT practice and rates for organisations.
- [Organisations](https://nexahubtech.company/for-business.md): Train your staff, your students or your team with NexaHubTech Academy: Microsoft Office taught at your office, CBT exam practice for schools, and any course for a group — online, in person or at your office.
- [Enrol](https://nexahubtech.company/enrol.md): Apply for a place at NexaHubTech Academy — taught live, online or in person, and started whenever you are ready. Tell us about you, pick your course and how you want to learn, and we'll agree your start date and session times.

## Courses

- [Computer Essentials](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/computer-essentials.md): Digital Literacy & PC Basics. Live online ₦65,000 (or 2 × ₦35,000) · In person ₦75,000 (or 2 × ₦40,000). 6 Weeks. From never having used a computer to managing files, browsing safely, and working with documents — with an instructor beside you every step.
- [Office Essentials](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/office-essentials.md): Word, Excel, PowerPoint & Access. Live online ₦80,000 (or 2 × ₦42,500) · In person ₦95,000 (or 2 × ₦52,500). 8 Weeks. The four programs an office actually runs on, taught to the standard professional work deserves.
- [AI for Office Use](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/ai-for-office-use.md): Prompting & Office AI. Live online ₦60,000 (or 2 × ₦32,500) · In person ₦75,000 (or 2 × ₦40,000). 4 Weeks. Master practical AI tools, prompt engineering, and their application across Microsoft Office to automate tasks and work faster.
- [Python Programming](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/python-programming.md): Live online ₦95,000 (or 2 × ₦52,500) · In person ₦115,000 (or 2 × ₦62,500). 6 Weeks. Learn programming from scratch with Python — the language that powers everything from scripts to AI.

- [Web Development](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/web-development-fullstack.md): Fullstack. Live online ₦200,000 (or 3 × ₦75,000) · In person ₦240,000 (or 3 × ₦87,500). 18 Weeks. Learn frontend and backend in one complete path — from first principles to full applications.

- [Mobile Development](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/mobile-development.md): Live online ₦190,000 (or 2 × ₦102,500) · In person ₦230,000 (or 2 × ₦125,000). 12 Weeks. Build real mobile applications — from concept to the app store.

- [Mobile Videography](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/mobile-videography.md): Phone video & editing. Live online ₦50,000 (or 2 × ₦27,500) · In person ₦60,000 (or 2 × ₦32,500). 4 Weeks. Shoot, light, record and edit video worth watching — on the phone you already own.
